_comment: Mass-deployment branding. Copy this folder to each PC, edit this file, put a PNG at the logo path, then Load unpacked (or force-install). Set enabled to true. locked:true applies org branding on every machine and disables the Branding tab. appName is the product name in ‘Open … in this browser’. appUrl makes that name a clickable http(s) link.
name: Your Organisation Bookmark Sync
